reasoning_steps: The text introduces new concepts related to funding and investments in wind energy that are not covered by existing classes.
Venture capital financing for start-ups is a specific type of private equity financing described in the text.

classes.aristotelian_definition: An IEA Classification Code is an Information Content Entity that categorizes R&D investments according to specific technology areas.
classes.comment: This class represents the classification codes used by the International Energy Agency (IEA) for categorizing wind energy R&D investments.

classes.aristotelian_definition: The Private RD&I Funding Share is a Quality that measures the proportion of private funding allocated to wind energy research and development.
classes.comment: This class represents the percentage share of global or regional private R&D investment in the wind energy sector.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A Venture Capital Investment is an Information Content Entity that represents financial support provided to start-ups and small businesses with high growth potential.
classes.comment: This class describes the type of private equity financing offered to innovative companies in the wind industry.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A Later Stage VC Investment is an Information Content Entity that represents financial support provided for scaling up start-ups or larger SMEs.
classes.comment: This class describes the type of venture capital investment focused on later stages of company growth.
